Marta (People Ops): Heads up — we've posted a small handbook amendment to the External Work / Moonlighting section. Please read and acknowledge by EOD Friday. Link: https://intranet.redwood.com/handbook/updates#moonlighting :memo:
Sam (People Ops): TL;DR of the change for folks who skim: managers must confirm any external engagements >5 hrs/week; employees still need prior written sign-off; update clarifies contractor vs employee exceptions.
Jordan (Eng): Quick q — does this change affect open-source contributions?
Priya (Legal): Short answer: OSS contributions = allowed, but must follow the contributor disclosure checklist in the appendix. If code would compete with Redwood products, escalate.
Sam (People Ops): Action items: 1) Everyone gets an email with e-sign link for the update; 2) Managers get a spreadsheet of direct reports who haven't acknowledged after 4 days; 3) People with conflicts will be routed to Legal + their manager.
Marta (People Ops): Spreadsheet (view-only): https://sheets.redwood.com/ops/handbook-ack-185250 — managers, please add two columns: "follow-up done" and "escalated to legal".
Jordan (Eng): Can managers bulk-ack on behalf of team members for admin reasons?
Priya (Legal): No — we need individual e-signatures for the policy itself. Managers can add notes in the sheet but not sign for them.
Sam (People Ops): Reminder: we'll run a 15-min open office hours tomorrow 10:30-10:45 for any questions. Join here: https://meet.redwood.com/ops/handbook-qna.
Marta (People Ops): For tracking, please use the subject prefix "Handbook Acknowledge" when emailing people who miss the deadline.
Jordan (Eng): Thanks — will ping my direct reports now.
Priya (Legal): One more thing — if someone declines to sign, please flag immediately and do NOT let them handle sensitive customer work until Legal reviews.
Marta (People Ops): Understood. We'll collect declines and triage next week.
TrainingBot: automated reminder sent to 42 users who haven't acknowledged yet — next reminder scheduled in 48 hours. :bell:
Sam (People Ops): Will follow up on escalations list mid-next-week and publish a short rollout note summarizing numbers and any recurring questions.
Marta (People Ops): Thanks all. If you see anything that reads poorly, DM me. :wave:
